## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (92%)** · Confident · Read in turn
- Single-class conformal prediction [F1], model consensus, and 0% invasive risk support routine tier-4 biopsy review.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 92%, Benign 6%, InSitu 2%, Invasive 0% | Strong Normal lead; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% target (alpha 10%) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 68% OOD (12/12 regions) [F6] | Typical image quality; not flagged |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (91%–94% similarity) [F5] | Unanimous match; InSitu contrast 89% |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 7, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.52) strongly pushes away from invasive carcinoma [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 4, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.18) [F3], but failed AI spot check (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 3, 9) · context · Above-typical score (1.06) [F4]; descriptive only (spot check 8/20) · Weak
- **Nuclear size and variation** (regions 0, 3, 11) · context · Mean 50 µm² (10th percentile) [F7]; size variation 90th percentile [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions beats random (drop +0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (drop +0.0008, CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); case leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Region 5 or 11 harbors in situ carcinoma, matching contrast case BACH_0347 (InSitu, 89% similarity on duct confinement/necrosis).
- Atypical nuclei in region 3 (25 neoplastic-flagged cells, pleomorphism 1.26) or 95th-percentile dead fraction [F9] reflect missed neoplasia.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 11**: Highest regional risk (3%), 8 neoplastic-flagged nuclei, and top necrosis score (0.37); exclude atypia.
2. **Region 3**: 25 neoplastic-flagged nuclei, 9 inflammatory cells, and peak pleomorphism (1.26) and invasion (0.39) scores.
3. **Regions 0, 4, 5, 10**: Verify normal lobules (Unreliable concept) and exclude duct atypia in region 5.
